description: The resource branch: IT4IT's Resource — an asset or other limited thing, allocated to a CI or free. Its lifecycle is the asset's (ordered … disposed, reusable), not the CI's. allowedBy: the values a field may take depend on another field of the same object (a port's speed on its kind); a value of that other field not listed admits none. keyVia: a key that is a field of a related object — an asset is known by any of its ports' MACs (D5); its rank orders it among the class's own keys.

resource.label: resource
resource.description: A resource: allocated to a CI or free.

faulty.description: A flag beside the stage: a device can be operational and faulty (D7, O3).

allocatedTo.description: The CI it is allocated to, or none.

asset.label: asset
asset.description: A physical thing. Named by a tag per kind (srv-01, sw-01, ap-01, dev-01; O5). Known by vendor + serial, then any of its ports' MACs, then its tag (D5).

keyVia.description: Any of its ports' MACs: a port in the same report that is part of it, matched to a stored port's MAC (D9: a MAC is unique across all ports).

model.description: A faceplate key where one exists.

serial.description: vendor + serial is the asset's key (D5).

location.description: The rack or room it stands in.

server.label: server
server.description: A server. The BMC is a port with role bmc.

nics.description: Every physical NIC, used or not (D15): name, MAC, kind, speed, link, bond or bridge. Volatile: its link state moves.

disks.description: Every disk in it (D15), by by-id name: device, vendor, model, serial, wwn, size, type, bus, SMART health, what it holds, partitions. No measurements (SMART attributes, temperature, wear): those are a disk CI's, volatile there. A disk its asset records is a disk CI besides.

network-device.label: switch or access point
network-device.description: A switch or an access point.

mac.description: The management MAC; its ports have their own.

appliance.label: modem, ONT or UPS
appliance.description: A modem, an ONT, a UPS.

other-device.label: other device
other-device.description: Anything else with a port: a USB network adapter, a printer.

port.label: port
port.description: A connector on an asset (D9): its name within its asset is its key.

plate.description: It comes from the asset's faceplate: the asset's record does not list it.

assignment.description: `switch-manager list-ports`: what a switch port is for, its VLANs against desired, its LAG and neighbours; `switch` names the switch, `actual` the MLAG facts.

name.description: The label on the case or the OS's name.

asset.description: The asset it is part of.

speed.description: The port's maximum; the negotiated link speed belongs to the connection.

module.description: What is plugged into an SFP cage.

role.description: What the node uses it for.

vlans.description: How it is set: mode, native, tagged.

seen.description: What is behind it: MAC, LLDP neighbour, lease.

disk.label: disk
disk.description: A disk in an asset: named by its tag (dsk-NN), its by-id name shown. Known by the asset it is in and its name; its serial is unique across all disks (asset-manager refuses a second). Moving it to another asset ends this CI and begins one there, so its history of placements is its CIs'. A pool is built-on it.

asset.description: The asset it is in (a server).

bay.description: The slot it is in: the server's label for it, else its by-id name.

serial.description: Its identity: unique across all disks, compared case-insensitively without whitespace and dashes.

wwn.description: Its World Wide Name, the identity after the serial.

procurement.description: As an asset's (supplier, orderRef, purchaseDate, warrantyUntil, ownership, notes); no prices.

disposal.description: As an asset's: how, when, wiped.

health.description: Proxmox's word from its disk list: PASSED, FAILED, UNKNOWN (site-manager report).

wearout.description: % of its rated life left (site-manager report --discover).

smart.description: The SMART attributes that matter: reallocated, pending, uncorrectable, mediaErrors, criticalWarning, powerOnHours (site-manager report --discover).

holds.description: What the whole disk holds: zfs, lvm, efi, a filesystem, nothing.

partitions.description: Its partitions: device, size, what each holds, its pool.

pool.label: consumable pool
pool.description: A consumable consumed by allocations (O10; no leaves yet).
